Each button sends one protocol frame to the chip through the board. The chip checks its CRC; the next vehicle's decision changes accordingly.

    Decided on the chip. The board's FPGA fabric only emulates the sensors and the tag reader; LaneX runs on the RVBL-2 core. Checked here. Every record's CRC-16 and every Chaskey-12 tag (ISO/IEC 29192-6) is recomputed in this page, independently of the chip.
